nodes.label: Event Pass ($29 one-time, one competition)
nodes.rationale: Shipped in v3/07 and never exercised end to end: undiscoverable, sells features it does not deliver (branding and realtime are DEAD), leaves no receipt, and dead-ends the buyer at its own quota ceiling. The payment rails themselves were verified healthy against live test-mode Stripe; the defects are all in the product layer.

nodes.label: Pass scoping requires a threaded competitionId
nodes.rationale: resolve() only consults the pass when the org resolves to community AND the caller threads competitionId. A call site that omits it makes the pass invisible — the single root cause of most defects, recurring at 27 call-site groups. Guarded by a new test that fails when an event_pass matrix key is resolved without a competitionId.

nodes.label: org_has_feature (V228) resolver drift
nodes.rationale: Four mechanisms added by migrations later than V228 are missing: pass awareness, expires_at, comped_until and the past_due grace. It was correct when written and was left behind; expired staff grants and lapsed comps therefore keep granting Pro on every public surface. Applied migrations are immutable, so the fix ships as V306+, never as an edit to V228.

nodes.label: public_players_v structural blocker
nodes.rationale: The view has no competition column because a person plays in many competitions; pushing the gate into the correlated exists() would mean 'some competition this person appears in is entitled', so one Event Pass would expose that person across every unpaid competition. Resolution: move the gate out of the view into the caller, which already knows the competition.

nodes.label: UpgradeGate PASS_FEATURES and gate states
nodes.rationale: The gate infers the pass CTA from usePathname() alone and cannot see whether the pass is owned; a competition layout resolving the pass once through a CompetitionPassProvider fixes it. At a pass quota ceiling the gate offers Pro only with goodwill copy — never re-sell a pass the org holds.

nodes.label: D12 — Event Pass credited toward Pro within 30 days
nodes.rationale: Delivered as a Stripe customer balance credit rather than a coupon because discounts and allow_promotion_codes are mutually exclusive in Checkout and both builders set the latter. The credit must attach to the customer that will be billed for Pro, so it is only correct after the customer-link fix.

nodes.label: D13 — pass holder keeps the trial but must supply a card
nodes.rationale: A pass never stamps trial_used_at, and trialDays > 0 implies payment_method_collection:'if_required'. An explicit requireCard argument is added rather than overloading trialDays, so Checkout defaults to 'always' and the missing_payment_method end_behavior becomes belt-and-braces.

nodes.label: D14 — subscriptions.currency pinned at first purchase
nodes.rationale: Only syncSubscription writes currency today, so a pass-only org keeps NULL and preferredCurrency falls through to cookie then Accept-Language — a buyer who paid £25 for a pass could be quoted USD for Pro later. Stamped on pass reconcile with the never-overwrite coalesce shape.

nodes.label: D19/D20 — registration.fee_percent ladder 8/5/2/1
nodes.rationale: registration.paid opens to community, monetised by fee rather than by gate. Community needs an EXPLICIT row — today it falls back to PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT (5), which would leave the pass no fee advantage at all. The pass's story becomes 'cheaper entry fees', not 'unlock entry fees'.

nodes.label: D18/D23 — branding vs dashboard.branding
nodes.rationale: Logo upload becomes table stakes on `branding` (community true) while the org theme colour stays Pro-only on `dashboard.branding`, keeping a visible Pro differentiator. The two keys must gate different controls — V310 left the brand-colour picker offered to Community while the colour is stripped at render, a control that silently does nothing.

nodes.label: reconcilePassCheckout must link the Stripe customer
nodes.rationale: Parity fix with reconcileCheckout: without linkStripeCustomer a pass-only org never gets a stripe_customer_id, so its billing page can show nothing at all and a second customer is minted when it later upgrades.

nodes.label: D8 — resolver unification (five resolvers to two)
nodes.rationale: Five resolvers exist; two are correct-ish and three drift. The app-side duplicates in the entitlements route and assertMayOwnAnotherOrg are deleted and call the real resolver, and the resolver work lands FIRST in the branch so the Event Pass work builds on a correct resolver.
